notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just updated the game to version 1.1.3, addressing two issues.

[list][*]Level 58 was missing an invisible wall, which would allow you to walk around the level's layout to reach the exit.
[*]Adjusted how the achievement Sapienta works. Before it required you to beat the whole game in a row without jumping around levels via level select. However, this is very unintuitive and unfriendly towards players. So now the achievement checks if you have beaten all the levels. To earn the achievement, simply launch the game, once in main menu, if you have beaten all the levels, you will just earn it.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update Release!
notes.notes:
[h2]The wait is finally over![/h2]
Dark Crypt's Major update is finally here and it comes with quality of life features, graphic improvements and more!

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*]FPS Limitation (optional)
[*]Choose your input style - HOLD & PRESS or PRESS ONLY
[*]Adjustable length between input readings in HOLD & PRESS input style
[*]Screen shake (optional)
[*]Gamepad rumble (optional)
[/list]

[h2]Graphical overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved menus
[*]The simple looking scroll used for telling the story is replaced by an animated journal
[*]New lighting effects in environment and for some enemies
[/list]

Enjoy the update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1706170/Dark_Crypt/

notes.title: Major update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it's a been while since Dark Crypt got an update! Sorry about the delay, but I've been working on a very special update and other things got in the way on top of that, especially my new game Sokobos!

[h2]Graphical Overhaul[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40951377/29b15a5e197c7942e667418aaad612ae98a61dbd.gif[/img]

A friend of mine has assisted me with the game's visuals, this new update will immerse you even further in the game and make you feel like you are in a dark crypt avoiding monsters which rely on light cast by torches for sight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40951377/c0305b790d43ba1d472377877125145b1215b725.gif[/img]
The change I am happiest about is the re-work of the simplistic looking scroll! Now our main character has his own personalized journal into which he writes his thoughts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40951377/8a4ebaadf490c2b287118b7d8772bdda98d7c71e.gif[/img]
The main menu screen also got some love!

[h2]Quality of Life features[/h2]
The new update will also include an option to turn on an FPS limiter, option to choose an input style - you will be able to select between HOLDING & PRESSING a key or only PRESSING for the movement. I will be also adding a toggeable camera shake and gamepad vibrations to go along with it.

[h2]When?[/h2]
The planned release date is 29th April 2022 as I am making sure everything works as intended and there are no issues with this new version! This huge update WILL NOT effect your current save file, so you'll be able to jump into this new version and continue playing as if nothing had happened.

[h2]Check out my new game while you wait![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1655890/Sokobos/
